screens.title: Inventory and activity, in context
screens.description: The admin overview separates population inventory, period activity and lesson-run states.

screens.title: The program across regions and schools
screens.description: Regional and school breakdowns retain group, learner and teaching context.

screens.title: Lesson delivery becomes inspectable
screens.description: Run statistics, duration and the actual lesson-run list appear together.

screens.title: See participation and work separately
screens.description: The native view distinguishes submitted versions, drafts and repeat submissions before listing learner activity.

screens.title: Nine ways to notice friction
screens.description: The native lens cards show signals, denominators and calculation disclosures. Some denominators count learner-run pairs rather than unique learners.

screens.title: Open the reasoning behind a number
screens.description: A native calculation dialog explains the no-show definition, threshold, formula and substituted values.

screens.title: Inputs and peers beside the indices
screens.description: The broader fictional cohort meets the comparison gates. VRI includes a fixed 0.8 stability assumption; these are modeled operational indices.

screens.title: A narrower scope changes what can be concluded
screens.description: The seven-day view has insufficient eligible peers and displays absolute values instead of a peer comparison.

screens.title: Understand the review workload
screens.description: Queue age, grade distribution and a class-by-lesson heatmap show different parts of the feedback pipeline.

screens.title: Follow the lesson through the work
screens.description: Started, submitted and reviewed activity remains distinct in the lesson progression and weekly reporting views.

screens.title: A teacher’s starting point
screens.description: The original instructor home opens the assigned classrooms and shows their school and content-pack context.

screens.title: A classroom hub with a lesson tree
screens.description: The sidebar keeps classroom context, learners, grades, questionnaires and statistics beside the selected lesson panel.

screens.title: The people inside the classroom
screens.description: The learner panel sits inside the classroom hub. All names and records in this capture are fictional.

screens.title: A grade matrix with different work states
screens.description: Scores, feedback-only work, work awaiting review and unfinished activity have distinct treatments in the native matrix.

screens.title: Learning activity with multiple perspectives
screens.description: Data lenses and filters connect participation, submitted work, feedback and revision patterns over time.

films.title: The program behind the classroom.
films.description: Explore the original admin and scoped school analytics: inventory, nine friction lenses, an open calculation, modeled indices, a comparison gate and the work behind the numbers.

chapters.title: Inventory and activity
chapters.description: The original BI view separates all-time inventory from activity within the selected period. Every figure comes from fictional local fixtures.

chapters.title: Nine friction lenses
chapters.description: Nine distinct lenses show different participation and workflow patterns. Labels and calculation controls remain visible in the original interface.

chapters.title: Open the calculation
chapters.description: The native No-Show explanation opens. A close-up retains its formula, variables and concrete substitution: one qualifying run out of 25 gives 4%.

chapters.title: Read modeled indices carefully
chapters.description: The 30-day modeled-index view includes five eligible peers. Its VRI calculation includes a fixed 0.8 assumption; these indices are not validated causal measurements of teaching quality.

chapters.title: Respect the comparison gate
chapters.description: A separately loaded seven-day slice has no eligible peers. Arc retains absolute values and explicitly withholds a fair peer comparison; this differs from the 30-day view shown before it.

chapters.title: Review queues and grade context
chapters.description: The scoped school analytics view displays review age, score distribution and a class-by-lesson grade matrix. A detail insert makes the matrix values readable.

chapters.title: Follow lesson progression
chapters.description: Started, submitted and reviewed counts stay separate along the lesson sequence, followed by a weekly trend view. This is fictional history, not reported live program impact.
